Gorilla in the Studio

摄影棚里的猩猩

A group of emory university photographers

Captured photos of a gorilla

In the forest next to visual arts building

They gave him a printed photo as gift

This happened last week

This is the first gorilla to appreciate human art

He didn’t make it out, but he made history
